STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.description: Procurement Legislation threshold for goods and services contracts (sub-central authorities)
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.defined_by: clause 1.4 and App B footnote *** refer to the Procurement Legislation and the Procurement intranet page
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_GOODS_SERVICES.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure, its source, and whether it is VAT-inclusive, before spend-analyst runs.

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSIONS.description: Procurement Legislation threshold for works and concession contracts
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_WORKS_CONCESSIONS.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure and its source.

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.description: Procurement Legislation threshold for light touch contracts
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_LIGHT_TOUCH.note: Not stated in the PDF. Auditor to supply the figure and its source.

STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_RELEVANT.description: 'the (relevant) Threshold': whichever of the three statutory thresholds above applies to the contract's category (goods & services, works & concessions, or light touch)
STATUTORY_THRESHOLD_RELEVANT.note: Not a separate figure; resolve per contract from the three category parameters. Where the category is unknown (e.g. a spend line), spend-analyst should state which threshold it applied.

notes: Version: no date or version is printed in the PDF; the title page reads 'Part [] Contract Rules' with the Part number left blank, and the footer shows only a working filename ($3inav0bz.docx).
Placeholders: App A row 3 refers to 'Parts [] (Call-In) and [] (Forward Plan)' with the Part numbers left blank.

VAT conflict: clause 6.15 lists 'Value Added Tax' as part of Total Contract Value, but the App B header states values are 'exclusive of VAT'. Spend data 'Net amount' is ex-VAT, which matches App B; the auditor should confirm which basis to apply.
Statutory threshold figures are not in the PDF (clauses 1.4, 6.5, App B footnote ***); they are held on the Procurement intranet page. Four parameters await auditor-supplied values.

£500,000 boundary gap: App A row 2 is 'less than £500,000' and row 3 is 'Above £500,000', so a contract of exactly £500,000 falls in neither row; App B rows B2 ('less than £500,000') and C ('Above £500,000') have the same gap. Clause 4.3 uses 'over £500,000'.
£2.5m boundary inconsistency: App A row 4 is labelled '£2.5million or more' but its cell says 'in excess of £2.5million'.

Who may grant exceptions: 7.2.2 allows an exception at the discretion of the Executive Director and/or Chief Executive, while 7.3 says only the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or exception; 7.2 is stated to be 'Subject to 7.4'.
7.2 sets exceptions for contracts 'more than £24,999.99', which aligns with the App B £25,000 band.

Drafting: 7.4.2 reads 'provided and an exception report' (garbled); App C row C circumstance text is garbled ('no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken ... ; or'); App C row E (variations) requires an 'extension report'; 11.5.3 reads 'or nominated officer who must ensure'.
Numbering: in section 5 the Transparency Code list items are numbered as clauses (5.1.1, 5.2, 5.2.1); 6.23 is a heading numbered as a clause with no text.

5.2 requires publication of details of every invitation to tender over £5,000 (Transparency Code), while App B row A says no advertising is mandated below £25,000; these are different obligations (publishing details vs advertising) but the auditor may wish to confirm practice.
App B row D and row C use 'should' for the CDP advert, and 6.8 uses 'should' for Portal advertising, whereas 6.10 and App B rows B1/B2 use 'must'.
App B footnote *** (three thresholds) has no *** marker in the table; footnote **** points to a local supplier policy that is not in the PDF.
No rule applies to purchases of £1,000 or less beyond 10.1 (written evidence of all purchases); App B row A starts 'Above £1,000'.
6.11 refers to tenderers 'from other member states' (EU-era wording).

rules.condition: service contract with estimated value exceeding the Goods & Services Threshold
rules.required_action: Record how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire (Social Value Act 2012 and Social Value Policy).
rules.verbatim_quote: When proposing to procure or make arrangements for procuring a service contract where the estimated value exceeds the Threshold for Goods & Services, consideration must be given as to how the procurement or contract might improve the economic, social and environmental wellbeing of West Berkshire, as required by the Public Services (Social Value) Act 2012, and the Council’s Social Value Policy.

rules.condition: every contract
rules.required_action: Enter a contract only in accordance with a decision of the Council, the Executive, or a decision-maker within the Scheme of Delegation.
rules.approver: the Council; the Executive; or, within the Scheme of Delegation, an Executive Decision Maker, a Council Committee or Sub-Committee, or an officer or their delegate
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts must be in accordance with a decision: 4.1.1 of the Council; or 4.1.2 of the Executive; or 4.1.3 within the Council’s Scheme of Delegation by: 4.1.3.1 an Executive Decision Maker; 4.1.3.2 a Council Committee or Sub-Committee; or

rules.condition: every contract
rules.required_action: Enter a contract only where an existing budgetary provision exists within the Council-approved Budget.
rules.verbatim_quote: No contract shall be entered into unless it is in accordance with an existing budgetary provision within the Budget approved by the Council.

rules.condition: contract award with a value over £500,000
rules.required_action: Treat the award as a Key Decision of the Council.
rules.approver: Key Decision of the Council
rules.verbatim_quote: Any contract award with a value over £500,000 is a Key Decision of the Council.

rules.condition: expenditure exceeding £500
rules.required_action: Publish details of expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors (Local Government Transparency Code 2015).
rules.verbatim_quote: Under the Local Government Transparency Code 2015, councils must publish: Expenditure exceeding £500, including payments to suppliers and contractors.

rules.condition: invitation to tender for goods and/or services contracts with a value exceeding £5,000
rules.required_action: Publish details of every such invitation to tender.
rules.verbatim_quote: Details of every invitation to tender for contracts to provide goods and/or services with a value that exceeds £5,000.

rules.condition: all contracts in progress and awarded
rules.required_action: Publish a register of contracts showing key information such as contract value, duration and supplier.
rules.verbatim_quote: A register of contracts, including those in progress and those awarded, with key information such as the contract value, duration and supplier.

rules.condition: contract information held by service areas
rules.required_action: Report contract information to the relevant board monthly in the format required by Procurement Legislation.
rules.verbatim_quote: Service areas are therefore responsible for reporting contract information to the relevant board on a monthly basis in a format as required by Procurement Legislation.

rules.condition: every person awarded a contract for supplies, services or works
rules.required_action: Check and record that the supplier meets the Council's minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing before award.
rules.verbatim_quote: Officers undertaking procurement are responsible for ensuring that all persons awarded contracts for the supplies, services or works to the Council meet the Council’s minimum standards of suitability, capability, legal status and financial standing.

rules.condition: contract opportunity above the relevant Procurement Legislation threshold (not a Further Competition under a compliant Framework Agreement)
rules.required_action: Advertise the opportunity on the CDP before it appears in any other advertising medium.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contract opportunities which are above the relevant Procurement Legislation thresholds must be advertised on the CDP database (a web-based portal provided by the Cabinet Office) prior to such advertisement appearing on any other advertising medium (such as a trade journal etc).

rules.condition: every CDP notice
rules.required_action: Have CDP notices approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate.
rules.approver: Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate
rules.verbatim_quote: CDP notices must be approved and issued by the Service Lead for Procurement and Commissioning or their delegate as appropriate, who will also assist in the conduct of the procurement.

rules.condition: any contract or requirement
rules.required_action: Do not artificially split or disaggregate a contract to avoid the Procurement Legislation or these Rules.
rules.verbatim_quote: There shall be no artificial splitting or disaggregation of a contract to avoid the application of the provisions of the Procurement Legislation and/or these Rules.

rules.condition: contract with an estimated value more than the appropriate Threshold
rules.required_action: Issue an electronic Invitation to Tender and receive tenders electronically via the Council's Procurement Portal.
rules.verbatim_quote: An electronic Invitation to Tender shall be issued by the Council for all contracts with an estimated value that is more than the appropriate Threshold and tenders shall be submitted electronically by tenderers via the Council’s Procurement Portal.

rules.condition: every electronic tender
rules.required_action: Specify the submission format in the Portal and ITT, and keep tenders locked in a secure portal account until the specified opening time.
rules.verbatim_quote: The Council Procurement Portal and the Invitation to Tender must specify the format in which an electronic tender is to be submitted by tenderers and such tenders shall be stored in a secure portal account which is locked until the date and time specified for its opening.

rules.condition: tender received after the specified opening time and date
rules.required_action: Reject late tenders unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied there are exceptional circumstances and other tenders have not been opened.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: No tender received after the time and date specified for its opening shall be accepted or considered by the Council unless the Monitoring Officer is satisfied that there are exceptional circumstances and the other tenders have not been opened.

rules.condition: every tender submitted on the Procurement Portal
rules.required_action: Have tenders opened electronically by a Procurement Officer, with an audit record kept on the e-tendering system.
rules.approver: Procurement Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: The electronic opening of tenders submitted on the Procurement Portal shall be conducted by a Procurement Officer with an audit record being maintained on the e-tendering system.

rules.condition: every quote and tender
rules.required_action: Evaluate quotes and tenders against evaluation criteria notified in advance to bidders.
rules.verbatim_quote: All quotes and tenders shall be evaluated in accordance with evaluation criteria notified in advance to those submitting quotes/tenders.

rules.condition: every contract award
rules.required_action: Award to the most advantageous quote or tender representing best value (not only lowest price), unless exceptional circumstances are approved in advance by the relevant Service Director.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (advance approval of exceptions)
rules.verbatim_quote: Save in exceptional circumstances approved in advance by the relevant Service Director all contracts shall be awarded on the basis of the quote or tender which is most advantageous and represents best value for money to the Council having regard to the provisions of the Social Value Policy, and not only on the basis of lowest price.

rules.condition: contract with a value of more than £24,999.99 where competition is excepted or waived
rules.required_action: Waive competition only (a) for contracts outside Procurement Legislation where urgency means delay would likely cause financial loss, injury or property damage, or (b) at the discretion of the relevant Executive Director and/or Chief Executive with reasons recorded in writing; subject to 7.4.
rules.approver: relevant Executive Director and/or the Chief Executive (7.2.2)
rules.verbatim_quote: Subject to 7.4 the requirement for the Council to conduct a competitive purchasing process, contracts with a value of more than £24,999.99, may be excepted or waived in the following circumstance:

rules.condition: any waiver or exception to these Rules
rules.required_action: Obtain the waiver or exception only from the Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer, sought in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and/or S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer and/or the S.151 Officer may grant a waiver or an exception to these Rules, subject to exception values and delegation thresholds detailed in these Rules and/or elsewhere in the Constitution. An officer who seeks a waiver of these Rules shall do so only in advance and only in exceptional circumstances.

rules.condition: exception for a contract up to the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain S.151 Officer approval of the exception.
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: for all contracts up to the Threshold, the S.151 Officer must approve the exception;

rules.condition: exception for a contract above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer consults the Monitoring Officer and appropriate Executive Director, with an exception report approved by the relevant board (retrospectively only where urgency under 7.3 prevents prior approval).
rules.approver: S.151 Officer, after consulting the Monitoring Officer and appropriate Executive Director; exception report approved by the relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts above the relevant Threshold and up to £500,000, the S.151 Officer will consult with the Monitoring Officer and the appropriate Executive Director provided and an exception report has been approved by the relevant board unless 7.3 applies and for reasons of urgency such prior approval is not possible in which case a report will be supplied retrospectively;

rules.condition: exception for a contract over £500,000
rules.required_action: S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer recommend to the Executive, with an exception report prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.
rules.approver: the Executive, on recommendation of the S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer; exception report approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board
rules.verbatim_quote: for contracts over £500,000 the S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer will make a recommendation to the Executive provided an exception report has been prepared and approved by the relevant board and Corporate Board.

rules.condition: every exception or waiver
rules.required_action: Fully document the exception or waiver.
rules.verbatim_quote: All exceptions or waivers to these Rules must: 7.5.1 be fully documented;

rules.condition: exception or waiver for a contract where competition is not excluded by Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Submit a written exception report, with reasons showing the waiver is genuinely required, to the relevant board in advance.
rules.approver: relevant board (report submitted by the relevant Service Director / Head of Service or Executive Director)
rules.verbatim_quote: for any contract where the requirement to hold a competitive process is not excluded by the Procurement Legislation, be subject to a written exception report to be submitted in advance to the relevant board by the relevant Service Director / Head of Service, Service Director or Executive Director (which shall include reasons for the exception or waiver which demonstrate that the exception or waiver is genuinely required);

rules.condition: every exception or waiver
rules.required_action: Obtain S.151 Officer approval recording that the reasons were considered and the circumstances are genuinely exceptional.
rules.approver: S.151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: be subject to approval by the S.151 Officer who shall record they have considered the reasons for the waiver and that they are satisfied that the circumstances justifying the waiver are genuinely exceptional (applications for waivers which are a result of poor contract planning will rarely be considered genuinely exceptional);

rules.condition: procurement using a Purchasing Scheme (framework, DPS, dynamic market, consortium etc.)
rules.required_action: Obtain and record advice confirming the Council may use the scheme, the purchases fall within its coverage, and the scheme complies with Procurement Legislation and Council requirements.
rules.verbatim_quote: An officer responsible for a procurement exercise may use a Purchasing Scheme provided that they have sought advice to confirm that:

rules.condition: contract awarded above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Produce a written procurement report documenting key decisions and steps leading to award.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director (author)
rules.verbatim_quote: A written report in accordance with the Procurement Legislation shall be produced by the relevant Service Director for each contract that is awarded which is above the Threshold and subject to the Procurement Legislation (the Procurement Legislation places an obligation on the Council to document, for each procurement, key decisions and steps taken and stages leading to the award of contracts).

rules.condition: the 9.1 written procurement report
rules.required_action: Retain the report for three years.
rules.verbatim_quote: This report may be requested by the Cabinet Office and shall be kept for three years.

rules.condition: every procurement procedure, regardless of value
rules.required_action: Document procurement progress and decisions, and keep the documentation for three years from contract award.
rules.approver: relevant Service Director
rules.verbatim_quote: In addition to the above, the relevant Service Director should document the progress of all procurement procedures (regardless of value) including ensuring sufficient information is kept to justify decisions such as communications with contractors and internal deliberations, preparation of procurement documents, any dialogue and negotiation, selection and award. Such documentation must be kept for three years from the award of the contract.

rules.condition: every purchase
rules.required_action: Hold written (including electronic) evidence of the purchase.
rules.verbatim_quote: There should be written evidence of all purchases (which shall include electronic evidence).

rules.condition: every contract within Appendix B
rules.required_action: Put the contract in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer (form of contract)
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts entered into by the Council as detailed in Appendix B must be in writing in a form approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: every contract sealed on behalf of the Council
rules.required_action: Have Legal Services retain the sealed contract documents.
rules.verbatim_quote: Legal Services shall retain all contract documents that are sealed on behalf of the Council.

rules.condition: award of every contract
rules.required_action: Formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement of the award so it is recorded on the Council Contract Register.
rules.verbatim_quote: The relevant Service Director must formally notify the Service Lead for Commissioning and Procurement (or nominated officer) of the award of all contracts for the purpose of it being recorded on the Council Contract Register.

rules.condition: every contract
rules.required_action: Include the standard clauses from the relevant Standard Form of Agreement.
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract shall include the standard clauses set out in the relevant Standard Form of Agreement issued and updated from time to time by the Monitoring Officer or their nominated officer and available from Legal Services.

rules.condition: contract where a Standard Form of Agreement is amended
rules.required_action: Have the amended form of contract approved by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer
rules.verbatim_quote: Where a Standard Form of Agreement is to be amended, the form of contract shall be prepared/amended by the relevant Service Director for approval by the Monitoring Officer or their delegated officer.

rules.condition: every contract, where appropriate
rules.required_action: Include minimum clauses: scope, timing, quality standards, insurance, consequences of default, legislative compliance, Bribery Act cancellation right, and payment within 30 days of a valid undisputed invoice flowed down to subcontracts.
rules.verbatim_quote: As a minimum, where appropriate, all contracts shall include clauses setting out:

rules.condition: every contract
rules.required_action: Complete a Data Protection Impact Assessment to inform the contract's personal-data clauses.
rules.approver: Service Directors (responsible)
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a Data Protection Impact Assessment is completed for all contracts to inform such clauses.

rules.condition: every contract
rules.required_action: Include relevant specifications and/or briefs/technical requirements that are enforceable.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts shall include relevant specifications and/or briefs/technical requirements which are prepared taking into account the need for effectiveness of delivery, quality, sustainability and efficiency (as appropriate) and the need to be able to enforce the delivery of those requirements.

rules.condition: contract where full indemnities are relaxed
rules.required_action: Relax full indemnities only with written authorisation from the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer (or nominees).
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and S.151 Officer or their nominated officers
rules.verbatim_quote: No relaxation of full indemnities releasing the Council from all liability whether provided by public liability insurance or other instrument shall be allowed unless authorised in writing by the Monitoring Officer and the S.151 Officer or their nominated officers.

rules.condition: contract where a performance bond is required
rules.required_action: Use a bond in a form approved by Legal Services and include it in the Invitation to Tender.
rules.approver: Legal Services (form of bond)
rules.verbatim_quote: The bond must be in a form approved by Legal Services and must be included in the Invitation to Tender.

rules.condition: contract estimated to exceed £500,000 for works (or time-bound supplies/services) where a performance bond is not considered necessary (11.2)
rules.required_action: Undertake a written risk assessment, seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property, and keep the risk assessment on the contract file.
rules.approver: Service Director for Finance and Property
rules.verbatim_quote: If a performance bond is not considered to be necessary, the relevant Service Director must: 11.4.1 undertake a risk assessment in writing; and 11.4.2 seek approval from the Service Director for Finance and Property; and 11.4.3 keep a copy of the risk assessment on the contract file for inspection.

rules.condition: every contract; insurance steps apply where the risk assessment identifies a need for insurance
rules.required_action: Risk-assess the contract and, where insurance is needed, set and verify adequate cover (and professional indemnity where relevant) in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property.
rules.approver: Service Director (in consultation with the Service Director for Finance and Property)
rules.verbatim_quote: Every contract should be assessed for risk. If the risk assessment identifies the need for insurance the Service Director must:

rules.condition: every affixing of the Seal
rules.required_action: Have the sealing attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or a designated officer.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them
rules.verbatim_quote: The affixing of the Seal shall be attested and witnessed in writing by the Monitoring Officer or an officer duly designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council.

rules.condition: every sealing of a document
rules.required_action: Record the sealing as a consecutively numbered entry in the sealing register, signed by the attesting person.
rules.verbatim_quote: An entry of every sealing of a document shall be made and consecutively numbered in a book or electronic record to be provided for the purpose and shall be signed (including a digital signature) by the person attesting the sealing.

rules.condition: goods, services, works or concession contract with value above the Threshold
rules.required_action: Execute the contract under seal.
rules.verbatim_quote: All contracts whether for goods, services, works or concession contracts the value of which is above Threshold shall be sealed.

rules.condition: document executed on behalf of the Council not required to be under seal
rules.required_action: Have it signed by the Monitoring Officer or a designated officer and recorded in the register of such documents.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer or an officer designated by them
rules.verbatim_quote: Where it becomes necessary to execute any document on behalf of the Council not required by law to be under seal, the Monitoring Officer or an officer designated by them in accordance with the delegated powers conferred by the Council shall be deemed to have authority to sign such a document accordingly. A register of such documents shall be kept by the Monitoring Officer or officer duly designated by them.

rules.condition: every instruction of Counsel
rules.required_action: Have Counsel selected and instructed only by the Monitoring Officer (or nominee).
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer (or nominated officer)
rules.verbatim_quote: Only the Monitoring Officer (or nominated officer) shall have discretion to select and instruct Counsel.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value up to the relevant Threshold
rules.required_action: Have the award made by the relevant Service Director or an officer nominated by them in writing.
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director (or officers nominated by the Service Director in writing)
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by the Service Director in writing) shall have delegated authority to award the contract.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value above the relevant threshold and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Award by the relevant Service Director following S151 Officer and Monitoring Officer recommendation, with a written report approved by the relevant board.
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director, following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer; written report approved by the relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: Relevant Service Director (following recommendation of the S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) shall have delegated authority to award the contract provided a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board.

rules.condition: Total Contract Value above £500,000 and less than £2.5million
rules.required_action: Award as a Key Decision by the relevant Service Director with the Portfolio Holder, on recommendation of the Executive Director, S151 Officer and Monitoring Officer, with a board-approved written report and Call-In / Forward Plan compliance.
rules.approver: Relevant Service Director in consultation with the Portfolio Holder (Key Decision), following recommendation by the Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer; written report approved by the relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: The award of these contracts shall be a Key Decision delegated to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder (following recommendation by the relevant Executive Director, S151 officer and Monitoring Officer) to award the contract provided: a) a written report by the relevant Service Director (or such officers as nominated by them in writing) has been provided and approved by the relevant board; and b) such decision have been made in accordance with Parts [] (CallIn) and [] (Forward Plan).

rules.condition: Total Contract Value £2.5million or more (cell text: in excess of £2.5million)
rules.required_action: Obtain Executive approval, via quarterly reports seeking delegated authority to the Service Director in consultation with the Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer.
rules.approver: the Executive (delegating to the relevant Service Director in consultation with the Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and Monitoring Officer)
rules.verbatim_quote: Contracts with a value in excess of £2.5million shall require Executive approval, which may be given as below. The Executive shall receive quarterly reports detailing contracts being procured and seeking delegated authority from Executive for the relevant Service Director / to award the contract following the procurement process in consultation with the relevant Portfolio Holder, S.151 Officer and the Monitoring Officer.

rules.condition: total value exclusive of VAT above £1,000 and less than £25,000
rules.required_action: Seek at least one quote from an appropriate source (no advertising mandated).
rules.verbatim_quote: At least one quote must be sought from an appropriate source.

rules.condition: goods or services, total value exclusive of VAT £25,000 or more and less than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources (including at least one SME/VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible) and publish a contract notice on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier ****(where appropriate and possible**). A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch contracts, total value exclusive of VAT £25,000 or more and less than £500,000
rules.required_action: Send invitations to quote via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources (including at least one SME/VCSE and one local supplier where appropriate and possible) and publish a contract notice on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: Invitations to quote must be sent via the Procurement Portal to at least three appropriate sources, including at least one SME* or VCSE* organisation and one local supplier **** (where appropriate and possible**). A contract notice must be published on the CDP

rules.condition: works, concession or light touch contracts, total value exclusive of VAT above £500,000 and less than the Threshold (works/concessions or light touch threshold as applicable)
rules.required_action: Run a full competitive tender seeking at least five written tenders via the Procurement Portal, with an advert on the Portal and information on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: Full competitive tender process applies and at least five written tenders must be sought via the Procurement Portal. An advert should be placed on the Portal together with information on the CDP

rules.condition: goods, services, works, concession or light touch contracts, total value exclusive of VAT above the Threshold
rules.required_action: Follow Procurement Legislation procedures: full competitive tender with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement Portal, advertised on the CDP.
rules.verbatim_quote: Procurement Legislation Procedures apply– full competitive tender process with at least five written tenders sought (where appropriate) via the Procurement portal. An advert should be placed on the CDP

rules.condition: competition not run because the contract is excluded under the Procurement Legislation
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and, where applicable, prior approval of the relevant board.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer (prior written approval); relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is excluded under the Procurement Legislation. Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: contract governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR)
rules.required_action: Record key decisions and follow the relevant PSR process.
rules.verbatim_quote: Where the contract is governed by the Provider Selection Regime (PSR) Key decisions must be recorded and the relevant process under PSR followed

rules.condition: contract awarded under a Purchasing Scheme without further competition
rules.required_action: Obtain prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and, where applicable, prior approval of the relevant board.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer (prior written approval); relevant board where applicable
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is being awarded under a Purchasing Scheme (refer to 8 above) of a type where no further competition is being undertaken a competition has already been undertaken on behalf of the Council or other public sector organisation; or Prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer is required and where applicable prior approval has been granted by the relevant board.

rules.condition: extension to an existing contract that provides for such extension
rules.required_action: Obtain S151 Officer approval of the extension.
rules.approver: S151 Officer
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is an extension to an existing contract where the existing contract provides for such extension. Approval of the S151 Officer

rules.condition: variation of scope of an existing contract (provided for in the contract or permitted by Procurement Legislation)
rules.required_action: Below the Threshold obtain prior written approval of the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer; above the Threshold obtain relevant board approval on a report with their recommendation.
rules.approver: Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer (below Threshold); relevant board on their recommendation (above Threshold)
rules.verbatim_quote: The proposed contract is a variation of the scope of an existing contract where the existing contract provides for such a variation or where the variation is a modification permitted under the Procurement Legislation. For contract value below the Threshold prior written approval from the Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer is required. For contract value greater than the Threshold, approval of the relevant board, following the submission of an extension report to the relevant board with recommendation from Monitoring Officer and S151 Officer

rules.condition: specified individual social care placements and packages (items a–f)
rules.required_action: Record the reasons for the choice of provider on the individual's case notes.
rules.approver: Service Directors (responsible)
rules.verbatim_quote: Service Directors must ensure that a record of the reasons for the choice of provider is maintained on the individual’s case notes.

rules.condition: any contract where an Appendix C exemption is applied, with annual or total value more than the Threshold
rules.required_action: Obtain approval of the relevant board.
rules.approver: relevant board
rules.verbatim_quote: In the interests of clarity where an exemption is applied all contracts with an annual or total value of more than the Threshold must be approved by the relevant board.

excluded.reason: legal basis (s.135 LGA 1972); no testable obligation
